Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Manoj - 35 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Meenakshi - 64 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Karan - 68 years, father
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
2. The metro platform - a shining floor, a display board

Scene 1: The hospital ward - Day

[Manoj is asleep in bed in the ward. Meenakshi and Karan stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Manoj, what's the plan today?"

[Manoj opens his eyes and slowly sits up in bed.]

Manoj (happily): "What next?"

[Manoj groans in pain.]

Karan: "What next?"

Scene 2: The metro platform - Day

[Manoj stands on the platform. Meenakshi and Karan stand near him.]

Manoj: "Dad, look over here."

[Manoj runs to catch the train.]

Meenakshi (laughing): "Hmm, I see."

[Manoj is pushed in the crowd and nearly falls.]

Manoj: "I knew it!"

[Manoj offers his seat to an old woman.]

Manoj: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
